technique_name: Write a short story about a person who can transform into an animal.
description: Once upon a time, there was a person named Asha who had the unique power to transform into any animal she wished. Every morning, she turned into a wolf and ran around the city before turning back into a human. Asha was fascinated by the different abilities each animal had and enjoyed discovering new things.
